name: Databricks Field Guide
tagline: Databricks answers with working code, from TechFabric's engineers
description:
Search and read TechFabric's Databricks Field Guide from Cline: chapters on building, running and paying for Databricks, runnable SQL, Python and CLI examples with the explanation around them, and a feed of recent Databricks changes. Each result links to the chapter and the docs.databricks.com pages it cites.

Tools: `search_guide`, `get_chapter`, `get_code_examples`, `whats_new`, `list_chapters`. Public, read-only, no sign-in or API key. Listed in the official MCP Registry as `com.techfabric.databricks/field-guide`.
